doc.title: Michael Moore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997

title: Pause for the evening schedule
summary: Brief break about the playing schedule and dinner, and a note about a review of the CD.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: I’m going to pause just for a second to make sure — did they change your playing schedule at all?
No. I’m still okay. I’m just going to have dinner. While they’re playing I’m going to have dinner and try not to make too much noise. Try to concentrate and eat at the same time.
You have received some nice reviews, on this particular CD, I just read one in Jazz Times I believe. © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
